turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Of course. Rule: after he, she and it, add -s (He lives). If the verb ends in a consonant + y, change y to -ies (She studies).

Your exercise: The baby ___ (cry) at night. Write only the verb.
